verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an MCP connection and registry platform, but the evidence never documents acting on many items at once. The CLI and API calls shown operate on one connection or tool at a time. Aggregating tools from multiple servers is a different capability (tool aggregation, not batch actions). The Oct 2026 shutdown of the API, CLI and SDKs further removes any operational surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
